_comment: WP5.2 — the domain manifest. The core (engine: server, hooks, web, SM-2, pacing, records) is domain-neutral and reads this file; a domain is DATA + a thin adapter (tutor layer, graders, labels, level scale). A future domain plugs in by adding an entry here plus its dirs — nothing else in the core changes. `default` is what a profile without an explicit `domain` field gets when inference fails.

math._open_practices_comment: 2026-10-08 (Albert): no open practices with a general model in math — it invents problems that do not add up and cannot check a calculation. Re-enable here (speaking/writing/reading) only with a math-trained model; the code paths stay.
